title: F1597 Investigation of Package 72 Damage Healing Mechanism and PDAS State Transfer
finding: Investigation of the Package 72 state-transfer defect establishes: (1) The 291 healing nodes (min Delta_d = -0.001661) are proved to originate from the unconstrained linear phase solve K_phase * (d_offset + Delta_d) = f(H_offset) in f42_experimental_offset_uel.for, which relaxed interpolated donor damage toward receiver discrete equilibrium in the absence of an inequality bound. (2) The Primal-Dual Active Set (PDAS) formulation strictly enforces Delta_d >= 0 (verified min Delta_d >= 0.0), eliminating 100% of damage healing. (3) Candidate donor candidate_donor_h0025.inp (SHA-256 4C82B66BDA1D925C...) is bitwise verified under frozen production UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (SHA-256 CE8D5EDCD2911DCB...), achieving l0/h = 3.0 resolution (a 2.0x refinement over Package 50). (4) Live PBS execution remains deferred under FAIL_CLOSED_OFFLINE_MODE until cluster reconnection.

healing_diagnosis.root_cause: The phase field equation in f42_experimental_offset_uel.for is solved as an unconstrained linear system K_phase * (d_offset + Delta_d) = f(H_offset). Because d_offset was interpolated independently from the donor mesh onto the receiver mesh, the discrete residual R_0 = f(H_offset) - K_phase * d_offset contained negative components at 291 nodes. Without an inequality constraint (Delta_d >= 0), the unconstrained solve produced negative increments (min Delta_d = -0.001661), violating phase irreversibility.

pdas_remedy.conclusion: PDAS formulation strictly enforces pointwise irreversibility Delta_d >= 0. Under PDAS, unconstrained healing (which caused 291 healing nodes in Package 72) is mathematically impossible, ensuring thermodynamic and physical admissibility.
